architectural-decision-records.why: the fix changes how esk-genesis projects the consumer manifest (it now carries testSha256), a decision with a real trade-off (guarded passthrough vs. hard-fail-at-genesis) that a future engineer would ask 'why' about, so it ships an ADR in the same change.
architectural-decision-records.what: wrote ADR-0111 recording the provenance-completeness problem, the three options considered, the chosen guarded-spread passthrough, and the honest limit that a malformed non-release source fails closed downstream rather than erroring at genesis.
quotes: Every architecturally significant change ships with an ADR in the same unit of work

judge-arch.why: the change adds and restructures manifest-generation logic, so before done it got a fresh-context review of every changed file against the four questions, with the guard-masks-a-missing-field concern as the adversarial focus.
judge-arch.what: dispatched a fresh-context subagent review of the full diff; it returned a per-file x four-question matrix (all cleared/n-a), executed the mutation to prove the new test discriminates, and verified the fixture change regresses nothing (49/49). The review entry is recorded in docs/arch-reviews/entries/.
quotes: These are not optional and not left to discretion. Every review does all of them.

verifiable-quality-gates.why: the fix is proven by a new discrimination test, so that test must itself be shown non-vacuous: it has to fail when the fix is removed, not merely pass with it present.
verifiable-quality-gates.what: added GENESIS ADR-0111 asserting the generated consumer manifest carries testSha256 (length 64 and equal to source) for every upstream gate, then reverted the esk-genesis spread and confirmed the test fails ('testSha256 must be carried through, got undefined'); restored, full suite 49/49.
quotes: test must FAIL when the check is replaced by a no-op

skeptical-audit.why: the claim 'genesis now produces a provenance-complete manifest' is a factual assertion that must carry an evidence state, a re-runnable source, and a named limitation rather than be presumed.
skeptical-audit.what: recorded the fix as proven (mutation failure + 49/49, re-runnable via node --test test/esk-genesis.test.mjs) and observed (11/11 real gates carry testSha256), with the named limitation that the consumer-side manifest-provenance gate was not run end-to-end against a live release asset.
quotes: If you cannot attach all three, you do not assert it.

pattern-selector.why: no new class, module, service, or data flow is designed; the fix adds one projected field to an existing manifest builder using the idiom already present for invoke/couples, so no pattern is selected.

enterprise-architecture-standards.why: no system, service, schema, or algorithm is designed or changed; the manifest shape gains one already-defined per-gate field, unchanged in structure.

owasp-secure-coding-bdd.why: no input, auth, session, secret, file, network, or dependency surface changes; the change projects a hash field already present in the trusted source manifest.

bdd-comprehensive-testing.why: no user-facing behavior or audience-visible use case changes; the change is an internal generator fix covered by a unit/discrimination test, not a Gherkin scenario surface.

comprehensive-test-strategy.why: the existing esk-genesis unit suite is the right layer and already covers this; no new integration, contract, load, or chaos layer is warranted for a one-field projection.

release-deployment-safety.why: this change does not cut or deploy a release; it will be folded into a later version bump via changelog.d per the existing release process.

sre-operational-readiness.why: no running service, endpoint, SLO, or alert; this is a build-time generator.

compliance-data-lifecycle.why: no personal or regulated data and no storage, retention, migration, or backup surface; the field is a content hash of a test file.

arch-encode.why: the caught defect is already guarded by a new discrimination test (GENESIS ADR-0111) and the upstream-integrity gate; no additional greppable arch-gate rule is needed beyond the existing provenance/integrity gates.

universal-browser-device-support.why: no browser or device surface; Node build-time code and JSON only.
